Greedy Meshing Algorithm | vercidium-patreon/meshing | DeepWiki
May 14, 2025The greedy meshing algorithm is a crucial optimization technique that enables efficient rendering of voxel worlds. By combining adjacent faces with identical properties, it significantly reduces the polygon count while maintaining the same visual appearance.
